title: Universal delta-functor embedding for quasi-coherent modules
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme over a field k with affine diagonal [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme], and let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. There is a monomorphism F \to F' of quasi-coherent O_X-modules such that H^p(X,F') = 0 for every p >= 1.

source.place: Tag 0BDY, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma coherent-lemma-affine-diagonal-universal-delta-functor, embedding into a sheaf acyclic for higher cohomology

proof.text: By quasi-compactness, choose a finite affine open covering $X=U_1\cup\cdots\cup U_t$. Put $U=\coprod_i U_i$ and let $j:U\to X$ be induced by the open immersions. The finite disjoint union $U$ is affine.

For every affine open $V$ of $X$, $j^{-1}(V)$ is the finite disjoint union of the affine intersections $U_i\cap V$. The intersections are affine by the affine-diagonal intersection lemma, and a finite disjoint union of affine schemes is affine. Hence $j$ is affine.

source.place: Tag 0BDY, proof of coherent-lemma-affine-diagonal-universal-delta-functor, first paragraph; Morphisms Lemma Tag 01S8

proof.text: There is a canonical map $F\to j_*j^*F$. It is injective on stalks: if $x$ belongs to $U_i$, the stalk map factors through the point $x'$ of the copy $U_i$ and then back to $F_x$, so the composite is the identity. Thus it is a monomorphism. Since $F$ is quasi-coherent, $j^*F$ is quasi-coherent on the affine scheme $U$.

source.place: Tag 0BDY, proof of coherent-lemma-affine-diagonal-universal-delta-functor, canonical map and stalk-injectivity paragraph

proof.text: By affine vanishing, $H^p(U,j^*F)=0$ for every $p>0$. The affine-morphism cohomology edge isomorphism for $j$ identifies $H^p(X,j_*j^*F)$ with $H^p(U,j^*F)$, so $H^p(X,j_*j^*F)=0$ for every $p\ge1$. Taking $F'=j_*j^*F$, which is quasi-coherent by the affine-morphism higher-direct-image statement, proves the conclusion.
